from ninja import Router, File, UploadedFile
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import EnterpriseUserProfile
from .schemas import AvatarUploadOutSchema

profile_upload_router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@profile_upload_router.post("/users/{target_user_id}/avatar", response=AvatarUploadOutSchema)
def upload_user_avatar(request, target_user_id: int, avatar_image: UploadedFile = File(...)):
    # Resolves user profile by target_user_id without checking caller identity
    profile = get_object_or_404(EnterpriseUserProfile, user_id=target_user_id)

    profile.avatar.save(avatar_image.name, avatar_image)
    profile.save()

    return {"user_id": profile.user_id, "avatar_url": profile.avatar.url}
diagnosis: upload_user_avatar accepts an avatar image and updates EnterpriseUserProfile by target_user_id. Because the endpoint does not verify that target_user_id matches the authenticated user (request.auth.id), any user on the enterprise intranet can overwrite the avatar image of any other employee or corporate executive.

corrected_code:
from ninja import Router, File, UploadedFile
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from ninja.errors import HttpError
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import EnterpriseUserProfile
from .schemas import AvatarUploadOutSchema

profile_upload_router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@profile_upload_router.post("/users/{target_user_id}/avatar", response=AvatarUploadOutSchema)
def upload_user_avatar(request, target_user_id: int, avatar_image: UploadedFile = File(...)):
    # Verify caller is updating their own profile or is a staff administrator
    if target_user_id != request.auth.id and not request.auth.is_staff:
        raise HttpError(403, "You can only update your own avatar")

    profile = get_object_or_404(EnterpriseUserProfile, user_id=target_user_id)

    profile.avatar.save(avatar_image.name, avatar_image)
    profile.save()

    return {"user_id": profile.user_id, "avatar_url": profile.avatar.url}
